mcp.note: model-emitted mcp__<server>__<tool>; parts sanitized like omp's mint in mcp/tool-bridge.ts mintMCPToolName: lowercased, [^a-z0-9_] runs -> _, underscore-collapsed and trimmed; a tool name prefixed '<server>_' loses that prefix; no 64-char cap applied here. bareTools: bare lean-ctx/context-mode names used in output-styles/atlas-orchestrator.md -> device names a real omp session mints (verified with `omp --print --no-session` listing ctx_ devices). Keys in claudeToOmp must contain no whitespace (phrase keys break on .md reflow); omp/hook-bridge.ts claudeNamesFor only reverse-maps keys matching /^[A-Z]\w*$/. cmux-browser (45 browser_* tools, devices xd://mcp__cmux_browser_<tool>): server list, read-only/state-changing/sensitive classes and the subagentAllow set live in mcp-servers.json browserServers; the server needs its underscoredServers entry because browser_<tool> would otherwise split at the doubled token.

agentGuard.note: Read by omp/agent-guard.ts. omp does not parse `disallowedTools` from agent frontmatter (omp 18.6.1: 0 hits for disallowedTools/permissionMode under pi-coding-agent/src), so the guard enforces agents/<name>.md `disallowedTools` on omp via a tool_call handler. Each key under `ompTools` is an omp tool name; `blockedByClaude` lists the Claude tool names whose presence in the agent's `disallowedTools` blocks that omp tool. `write` is blocked only when its `path` is NOT a URI-scheme target (uriSchemeRegex), because omp's `write` also carries `xd://` MCP device calls, outbound IRC (`agent://`) and shared artifacts (`local://`, `proc://`); removing `write` from the child would break all of those. Shell writes through `bash` are NOT covered. `notApplicable` Claude names have no omp equivalent and are recorded here so the omission is explicit.
